answer: Distinct Physical Residency Ledger**. An identity registers by proving ongoing occupancy of a unique physical address: a tamper-evident meter reading tied to a ferrous utility line, signed at irregular intervals by the site itself. Operators cannot harbor multiple identities behind one address because the ledger enforces one active meter per coordinate and cross-checks readings against a delta across independent utility records. Faking a second valid address costs real installation, connection fees, and continuous consumption, paid per identity.
